from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Extract the 'quoted' responses for each documentation format
quoted_responses = {}
for col in documentation_columns:
    quoted_responses[col] = df[df[col] == 'quoted'].shape[0]

# Convert the quoted responses to a list
quoted_list = list(quoted_responses.values())

# Perform bootstrapping to estimate the confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((quoted_list,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95)

bootstrap_result

from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Create a contingency table for the 'quoted' responses
contingency_table = pd.DataFrame(quoted_responses, index=['Quoted']).T

# Perform chi-squared test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
